title: Middleware Basics
description: Understand the middleware pipeline in ASP.NET Core.

data.text: **Middleware** are components that form the request pipeline. Each component can process requests and responses in sequence.
Requests flow through middleware in order. Each middleware can process the request, pass it to the next middleware, or short-circuit the pipeline.

data.title: Pipeline
Order Matters
data.text: Middleware executes in the order it's added. Place exception handling early, authentication before authorization.

terms.definition: Software components assembled into an application pipeline to handle requests and responses.
The ordered sequence of middleware delegates that process an HTTP request.
A delegate that can handle an HTTP request, representing the next middleware in the pipeline.
When middleware handles a request without calling the next delegate, stopping further pipeline execution.

data.caption: How a request flows through the middleware pipeline
data.definition:
sequenceDiagram
    participant Client
    participant MW1 as Middleware 1
    participant MW2 as Middleware 2
    participant MW3 as Middleware 3
    participant Endpoint
    Client->>MW1: HTTP Request
    MW1->>MW2: Process & forward
    MW2->>MW3: Process & forward
    MW3->>Endpoint: Final handler
    Endpoint-->>MW3: Response
    MW3-->>MW2: Response
    MW2-->>MW1: Response
    MW1-->>Client: HTTP Response
